description: The MHH OSCE is the final examination of the second-year module 'Diagnostic Methods', taken at the end of the second academic year en route to M1.
title: The Hannover Medical School (MHH) OSCE in the module 'Diagnostic Methods'

description: The Hannover Medical School selection procedure ranked applicants on a weighted Total score from 0 to 15 points, calculated as 0.49 × Interview grade + 0.51 × Abitur grade, with the Abitur dominant by legal requirement.
title: MHH semi-structured selection interview procedure with weighted total score (49% interview, 51% Abitur)

description: A virtual TBL session delivered in the Meta Horizon Workroom with Meta Quest 2 headsets, in which students created avatars and collaborated on a pharmacology case scenario about hypertension and its treatment.
title: Meta Horizon Workroom team-based learning session for pharmacology (60-minute virtual application exercise)
